Keywords: how not what | temporal grammar | not classifier
Q_EN: How is this different from traditional activity recognition? | Isn't your system just a gesture classifier? | What makes your semantic layer novel compared to action recognition?
Q_ZH: 这与传统的动作识别有何不同？ | 你的系统不就是一个手势分类器吗？ | 相比动作识别，语义层的新颖之处在哪？
A_EN: Unlike activity recognition which classifies WHAT you are doing, our layer segments HOW the rhythmic effort unfolds. It acts as a temporal grammar, not a categorical label.
A_ZH: 与动作识别分类"你在做什么"不同，我们的语义层分割的是发力"如何"按时间展开。它是时间语法，不是分类标签。
Analogy_EN: MIDI sends note events, not sound. We send phase events, not raw signal.
Analogy_ZH: MIDI 传的是音符事件，不是声音。我们传的是阶段事件，不是原始信号。
Principles: 实时响应优先 | 能量驱动 | 方法独立 | 探索性轻量 | 鲁棒抗漂移 | 设备无关抽象 | 数据透明 | 用户节奏自由

Keywords: energy in-out-rest | 3 phases | minimal set
Q_EN: Why did you choose Stroke, Coast, and Idle? | Could there be a fourth phase? | What is the physical basis for these specific states?
Q_ZH: 为什么选择发力、滑行和静息这三个阶段？ | 会有第四个阶段吗？ | 这三个状态的物理基础是什么？
A_EN: They represent the fundamental energy transitions of rhythmic exertion: injection, dissipation, and ground state. This triadic structure is minimal yet sufficient to capture the dynamics of repetitive activities.
A_ZH: 它们代表了节律性运动的基本能量转换：注入、耗散和基态。这种三元结构极简，但足以捕捉重复性活动的动力学特征。
Analogy_EN: Like MIDI note-on, note-off, and silence. Three events cover the full cycle.
Analogy_ZH: 就像 MIDI 的按下、松开、静默。三个事件就能覆盖整个周期。

Keywords: middleware layer | no hardware lock | reuse visuals
Q_EN: How does Row-to-Flow differ from commercial platforms like Zwift? | What is the advantage over existing smart rowers? | Why not map sensors directly to the game?
Q_ZH: Row-to-Flow与Zwift等平台有何不同？ | 相比现有智能划船机有什么优势？ | 为什么不直接把传感器映射到游戏里？
A_EN: Commercial platforms tightly couple specific hardware to specific visuals. We insert a middleware semantic layer, allowing the same rhythmic grammar to drive diverse devices and rendering engines independently.
A_ZH: 商业平台将特定硬件与视觉强绑定。我们插入中间件语义层，允许相同的节奏语法独立驱动不同的设备和渲染引擎。
Analogy_EN: Zwift is a proprietary cable. We are MIDI: any keyboard, any sound module.
Analogy_ZH: Zwift 像专用线缆。我们像 MIDI：任何键盘，任何音源。

Keywords: real-time FSM | offline tracker | different jobs
Q_EN: Why use a fixed FSM for rendering but an adaptive one for evaluation? | Isn't the dual-track algorithm inconsistent? | Why not use the adaptive FSM for real-time?
Q_ZH: 为什么渲染用固定FSM，评估却用自适应算法？ | 双轨算法难道不是前后矛盾吗？ | 为什么不把自适应FSM用在实时渲染上？
A_EN: It's a deliberate dual-track architecture. The fixed FSM keeps interaction latency below the perceptual threshold for live rendering, while the offline adaptive tracker rigorously captures physical energy dissipation without method bias.
A_ZH: 这是刻意设计的双轨架构。固定FSM让实时渲染的交互延迟低于感知阈值，而离线自适应追踪器严谨捕捉物理能量耗散，避免方法偏倚。
Analogy_EN: Like live MIDI for performance and high-resolution MIDI for recording.
Analogy_ZH: 就像现场 MIDI 用于演出，高分辨率 MIDI 用于录音。

Keywords: 400ms cooldown | filters jitter | no delay felt
Q_EN: Doesn't the 400ms cooldown create interaction latency? | How do you handle fast strokes with a fixed cooldown? | Will users feel delayed feedback due to the timer?
Q_ZH: 400ms的固定冷却不会产生交互延迟吗？ | 你怎么用固定冷却处理快速的划船动作？ | 定时器会让用户感觉到反馈延迟吗？
A_EN: We empirically tuned the 400ms cooldown based on pilot observations. It filters out high-frequency mechanical chattering without causing perceived latency, ensuring a fluid real-time experience.
A_ZH: 我们基于先导观察经验性调校了400ms冷却。它过滤高频机械抖动且不会产生感知延迟，确保流畅的实时体验。

Keywords: 1.5s median | drift suppressed | no false triggers
Q_EN: How does the system handle machine wobbling or slow rowing? | Does gravity tilt affect your IMU readings? | How do you cancel out low-frequency noise?
Q_ZH: 系统如何处理机器晃动或缓慢划船？ | 重力倾斜会影响IMU读数吗？ | 你们如何消除低频噪音干扰？
A_EN: We use a 1.5-second rolling-median dynamic baseline to suppress slow drift and gravity projection changes. The rolling median continuously updates the baseline, so minor hand tremors are less likely to trigger false strokes.
A_ZH: 我们使用1.5秒滚动中位数动态基线抑制慢漂移和重力投影变化。滚动中位数持续更新基线，使微小手抖更不易触发错误发力。

Keywords: no self-eval | find_peaks | independent probe
Q_EN: Why use find_peaks for CV calculation instead of your FSM? | Isn't it unfair to compare using a different algorithm? | How did you calculate the cycle intervals objectively?
Q_ZH: 为什么用find_peaks计算CV而不是你们的FSM？ | 用不同的算法比较不是不公平吗？ | 你是如何客观计算周期间隔的？
A_EN: Using the semantic FSM to evaluate itself introduces method bias. We used find_peaks as an independent, drift-agnostic topographic probe to objectively measure true physical human motion across both conditions.
A_ZH: 用语义FSM自我评估会引入偏倚。我们使用find_peaks作为独立的、抗漂移的地形探针，以客观测量两种条件下的真实物理动作。

Keywords: area under curve | bigger pull | longer coast
Q_EN: How exactly does the adaptive energy-informed tracker work? | How do you calculate the coast duration offline? | What does t_coast proportional to effort mean?
Q_ZH: 自适应能量追踪器具体是如何工作的？ | 你们离线如何计算滑行时间？ | 滑行时间与发力成正比是什么意思？
A_EN: It computes the integral area under the rectified effort envelope. Greater energy injection during the stroke mathematically extends the estimated coast duration, perfectly mirroring physical momentum dissipation.
A_ZH: 它计算整流发力包络线下的积分面积。发力期注入的能量越大，估算的滑行时间越长，完美映射了物理动量的耗散。

Keywords: P02 retained | data-driven rule | transparency
Q_EN: Why was P02 excluded from the paired t-test but kept in the figures? | Was P02's data deleted? | Why not remove P02 entirely from the paper?
Q_ZH: 为什么 P02 被排除在配对 t 检验外，但保留在图中？ | P02 的数据被删了吗？ | 为什么不彻底删掉 P02？
A_EN: P02 was excluded automatically by a pre-defined, data-driven criterion due to fewer than three valid cycle intervals in one condition, but kept in all figures to demonstrate transparency. This is not manual cherry-picking.
A_ZH: P02因某一条件下有效周期间隔少于三个，被预先定义的数据驱动规则自动排除，但保留在所有图中以展示透明度。这不是手动挑选。
Analogy_EN: Like a bad MIDI take that you still keep in the session file
Analogy_ZH: but don't mix into the final track.
Audio_Q: 就像一个录坏的 MIDI 片段，你保留在工程文件里，但不混进最终成品。

Keywords: ESP32 + IMU | cheap | strap on anything
Q_EN: Is the hardware required for this semantic layer expensive? | Can I attach this to my home rower? | What is the material cost of your sensing module?
Q_ZH: 实现这个语义层所需的硬件昂贵吗？ | 我能把它装在我家里的划船机上吗？ | 你们传感模块的物料成本是多少？
A_EN: Not at all. The core setup relies on an ultra-low-cost ESP32 microcontroller and a standard 6-axis IMU, which can be easily strapped onto existing, affordable fitness equipment.
A_ZH: 完全不。核心设置仅依赖极低成本的ESP32微控制器和标准6轴IMU，可轻松绑在现有的经济型健身器材上。

Keywords: N=11 | trend not proof | future large N
Q_EN: Is a sample size of 11 enough to draw valid conclusions? | Why didn't you recruit more participants? | Does the small N limit your claims?
Q_ZH: 11人的样本量足以得出有效结论吗？ | 为什么不招募更多参与者？ | 小样本量会限制你们的主张吗？
A_EN: As an exploratory short paper, our goal is hypothesis generation and observing behavioral trends, not confirmatory validation. The robust effect sizes we observed strongly justify future large-scale studies.
A_ZH: 作为探索性短文，我们的目标是生成假设和观察行为趋势，而非确认性验证。我们观察到的稳健效应量充分证明了未来大样本研究的价值。

Keywords: P02 excluded | 0 valid cycles | auto rule
Q_EN: Why was participant P02 excluded from the paired t-test? | Did you manually remove outliers to get better results? | How was the exclusion criterion decided?
Q_ZH: 为什么参与者 P02 被排除在配对 t 检验外？ | 你们是为了结果好看手动删了异常值吗？ | 排除标准是怎么定的？
A_EN: P02 was excluded automatically by a pre-defined, data-driven criterion due to fewer than three valid cycle intervals in one condition. This is not manual cherry-picking. Their raw data is fully preserved and visualized in our raster plots.
A_ZH: P02因某一条件下有效周期间隔少于三个，被预先定义的数据驱动规则自动排除，绝非手动挑选。其原始数据完整保留并在光栅图中展示。

Keywords: counterbalanced | 30s warmup | no order bias
Q_EN: Did the order of conditions affect the user preference? | How did you handle learning effects during the 3-minute trials? | Was the study counterbalanced?
Q_ZH: 条件顺序是否影响了用户偏好？ | 你们怎么处理3分钟测试里的学习效应？ | 实验有做平衡序处理吗？
A_EN: The conditions were strictly counterbalanced to negate order effects. Additionally, participants received a 30-second familiarization phase before the recorded 3-minute trials to stabilize their motor behavior.
A_ZH: 实验条件经过严格的平衡序处理以抵消顺序效应。此外，在录制的3分钟测试前，受试者有30秒的熟悉期以稳定运动行为。

Keywords: p = 0.144 | d = 0.506 | exploratory
Q_EN: Your p-value is 0.144. Why is it still meaningful? | How do you justify conclusions with p > 0.05? | What does the Cohen's d of 0.506 mean here?
Q_ZH: p值是0.144，为什么还有意义？ | p>0.05怎么支撑结论？ | 这里的Cohen's d 0.506意味着什么？
A_EN: While limited by our exploratory sample size, the medium effect size (Cohen's d > 0.5) suggests a clear behavioral trend: the semantic layer afforded users rhythmic freedom rather than robotic constraint.
A_ZH: 虽然受限于探索性样本量，但中等效应量(d > 0.5)提示了清晰的行为趋势：语义层赋予了用户节奏自由，而非机械限制。

Keywords: higher CV | participant behavior | not algorithm bias
Q_EN: Doesn't a higher CV mean the semantic layer worsened their motor control? | Why is a higher cycle variation a good thing? | Did the users row worse in your system?
Q_ZH: CV变高不就意味着语义层让运动控制变差了吗？ | 为什么周期变异度变高是好事？ | 用户在系统里划得更差了吗？
A_EN: Not at all. Continuous mapping coerces users into rigid metronomic pacing. The higher CV reflects participant behavior—the semantic feedback encouraged more variable pacing strategies. Importantly, the CV was computed using an independent drift-agnostic peak detector, not the real-time FSM, so this difference is not algorithmic bias.
A_ZH: 完全不是。连续映射强迫用户像节拍器一样死板。较高的CV反映的是参与者行为——语义反馈鼓励了更多变的配速策略。重要的是，CV是用独立的抗漂移峰值检测器算的，不是实时FSM，所以这个差异不是算法偏差。

Keywords: semantics not equal aesthetics | mixed pref | decoupled
Q_EN: If the semantic layer is so good, why was overall subjective preference mixed? | Why did 4 people prefer the baseline? | Is your visual design flawed?
Q_ZH: 如果语义层这么好，为什么整体主观偏好是混合的？ | 为什么有4个人更喜欢基线？ | 你们的视觉设计有缺陷吗？
A_EN: This reveals a profound design insight: physical semantics and visual aesthetics can be decoupled. The structure successfully entrained their pacing, but some users simply preferred natural scenic presentation over cybernetic overlays.
A_ZH: 这揭示了深刻的设计洞见：物理语义和视觉审美可以解耦。结构成功引导了配速，但部分用户纯粹更喜欢自然风景而非赛博特效。

Keywords: stage clarity | pull-glide-return | internalized
Q_EN: What specific aspect of the semantic layer did users prefer? | How did users describe the semantic experience? | Why did 7 out of 11 favor stage clarity?
Q_ZH: 用户到底更喜欢语义层的哪个具体方面？ | 用户如何描述语义体验的？ | 为什么大比例偏好阶段清晰度？
A_EN: Users overwhelmingly preferred the Stage Clarity. Qualitatively, their descriptions shifted from force-centric words like "pull hard" to temporal grammar like "pull, glide, return," proving the semantic internalization.
A_ZH: 用户压倒性地偏好"阶段清晰度"。定性上看，描述从"用力拉"等发力词汇，转向了"拉、滑、回"的时间语法，证明了语义的内化。

Keywords: 4x amplitude | same 3 phases | PoC only
Q_EN: Does the respiratory trainer actually prove cross-device interoperability? | Why use a breathing trainer? | Isn't one extra device too weak for a claim?
Q_ZH: 呼吸训练器真的能证明跨设备的互操作性吗？ | 为什么用呼吸训练器？ | 仅仅多一个设备不足以证明通用性吧？
A_EN: It provides preliminary feasibility, not formal validation. Despite a 4x amplitude difference and distinct mechanics, the three-phase decomposition remains structurally similar, which is highly promising for cross-modal transferability.
A_ZH: 它提供的是初步可行性，而非正式验证。尽管振幅相差4倍且力学不同，三阶段分解在结构上仍保持相似，这展现了极佳的跨模态潜力。
Analogy_EN: Like a MIDI drum machine plugged into the same protocol.
Analogy_ZH: 就像一台 MIDI 鼓机插入了同一个协议。

Keywords: piston rectifies | impact events | reuse pipeline
Q_EN: How did you map continuous breathing into discrete strokes? | What does the custom pneumatic piston do? | Why are the respiratory signals so sharp?
Q_ZH: 你是如何把连续呼吸映射成离散Stroke的？ | 定制气动活塞起什么作用？ | 为什么呼吸信号看起来这么尖锐？
A_EN: The custom pneumatic piston mechanically rectifies bidirectional airflow into repeatable, high-frequency impact events. This allows us to reuse the exact same semantic extraction pipeline designed for rowing.
A_ZH: 定制气动活塞在机械上将双向气流整流为可重复的高频撞击事件。这让我们能完全复用为划船设计的同一个语义提取管线。

Keywords: find_peaks ref | no mocap | future benchmark
Q_EN: Where is the ground truth, error analysis, or formal latency estimate? | Why didn't you use motion capture cameras? | How accurate is the FSM without ground truth?
Q_ZH: ground truth、误差分析或延迟估计在哪里？ | 为什么不用动捕相机？ | 没有真值，FSM准确度如何？
A_EN: As an exploratory short paper, we used a drift-robust offline peak detector as our algorithmic reference rather than high-precision motion capture. Formal benchmarking remains vital for future work.
A_ZH: 作为探索性短文，我们使用抗漂移的离线峰值检测器作为算法参考，而非高精度动捕。正式的基准测试是未来工作的重要内容。

Keywords: low-pass | force-to-speed | inertia term
Q_EN: How exactly did the baseline condition map the sensor data? | Did the baseline have any filtering? | Why did you use an inertia term in the baseline?
Q_ZH: 基线条件到底是如何映射传感器数据的？ | 基线有加滤波吗？ | 为什么基线里要加惯性项？
A_EN: The baseline used a continuous low-pass filter and a direct force-to-speed mapping with an inertia term. This ensured smooth visual dynamics without any discrete phase segmentation, representing current commercial standards.
A_ZH: 基线使用了连续低通滤波和带惯性项的直接力-速度映射。这确保了无离散阶段的平滑视觉动态，代表了当前的商业标准。

Keywords: 4-page limit | OSF data | open scripts
Q_EN: Your paper lacks some experimental and demographic details. Why? | Where can I find the questionnaire items? | Are the scripts available?
Q_ZH: 你的论文缺乏实验和人口统计细节，为什么？ | 我在哪能找到问卷题目？ | 脚本公开了吗？
A_EN: Due to the strict 4-page limit, we prioritized core concepts. However, we have fully open-sourced participant demographics, ethics protocols, and analysis scripts in our anonymized OSF repository for complete transparency.
A_ZH: 受限于严格的4页篇幅，我们优先展示核心概念。但我们在匿名OSF仓库中完全开源了人口统计、伦理协议和分析脚本，以保证完全透明。

Keywords: renderer subscribes | stroke burst | idle calm
Q_EN: Why did you choose particles and trails for visual feedback? | How does the visual layer respond to the phases? | Are the visuals hardcoded?
Q_ZH: 为什么选粒子和轨迹作为视觉反馈？ | 视觉层如何响应语义阶段？ | 视觉效果是写死在代码里的吗？
A_EN: Visuals are an independent design dimension. We subscribed the renderer to the event stream: Stroke drives intense particles, Coast leaves decaying trails, and Idle returns to ambient flow.
A_ZH: 视觉是独立的设计维度。我们让渲染器订阅事件流：Stroke驱动强烈粒子，Coast留下衰减轨迹，Idle恢复到环境流动。
Analogy_EN: Like a MIDI synthesizer responding to note events, not to the keyboard brand.
Analogy_ZH: 就像 MIDI 合成器响应音符事件，而不是响应键盘品牌。

Keywords: handle IMU | cycling needs crank | weightlifting needs EMG
Q_EN: Can this exact handle-mounted IMU approach be used for cycling or weightlifting? | Will it work for non-rhythmic sports? | What limits your approach?
Q_ZH: 这套手柄IMU方法能直接用于骑行或举重吗？ | 它能用于非节律性运动吗？ | 你们方法的局限在哪？
A_EN: Not necessarily. While the semantic grammar applies, continuous rotary motions like cycling may require crank sensors, and isometric holds like weightlifting may require EMG. We stated this boundary in the limitations.
A_ZH: 不一定。虽然语义语法适用，但骑行等连续旋转运动可能需曲柄传感器，举重等静态保持可能需肌电图。我们在局限中说明了此边界。

Keywords: rectified effort | recoil = coast | no false stroke
Q_EN: How does your system handle the return motion or negative acceleration? | Does pushing the handle back trigger a stroke? | What happens when the handle retracts?
Q_ZH: 系统如何处理回桨动作或负加速度？ | 把手推回去会触发Stroke吗？ | 把手缩回时会怎样？
A_EN: The system operates on rectified effort magnitude, abstracting physical motion into a pure kinetic energy stream. Therefore, the recoil phase does not trigger false strokes but falls naturally into the Coast or Idle decay.
A_ZH: 系统基于整流后的发力幅度运行，将物理运动抽象为纯动能流。因此，回桨阶段不会触发错误发力，而是自然落入Coast或Idle衰减中。

Keywords: self-paced | consent signed | ethics in OSF
Q_EN: Was there any injury risk during the 3-minute max effort row? | Did you get ethical approval? | How did you ensure participant safety?
Q_ZH: 3分钟尽力划船有受伤风险吗？ | 你们有伦理审批吗？ | 如何保证参与者安全？
A_EN: Participants were instructed to row at a self-selected pace rather than maximum effort. Full informed consent was obtained, and the ethics statement is documented in our OSF repository.
A_ZH: 我们指示参与者以自选配速划船，而非极限发力。获取了完整的知情同意，伦理声明已记录在OSF仓库中。

Keywords: whoosh sound | marks stroke | audio future work
Q_EN: What role did the whoosh sound play in your experiment? | Was the feedback only visual? | Did audio help entrainment?
Q_ZH: 呼啸声在实验中起什么作用？ | 反馈仅仅是视觉的吗？ | 声音有助于节律同步吗？
A_EN: The visual feedback was reinforced by a distinct 'whoosh' sound marking the stroke onset. This multimodal approach strengthens the perception of phase boundaries, though analyzing audio contribution independently remains future work.
A_ZH: 视觉反馈辅以标记Stroke起点的清晰呼啸声。这种多模态方法强化了对阶段边界的感知，不过单独分析声音的贡献留待未来研究。

Keywords: retrofit any | irregular moves | next step
Q_EN: Can this be deployed in commercial gyms tomorrow? | Does it require specialized rowing machines? | What is the barrier to productization?
Q_ZH: 这个明天就能部署到商业健身房吗？ | 它需要专用划船机吗？ | 产品化的障碍是什么？
A_EN: It can be retrofitted to any existing equipment using a low-cost IMU. However, commercial deployment would require expanding the segmentation strategies to handle irregular compound movements, which is our next step.
A_ZH: 利用低成本IMU，它可加装在任何现有设备上。但商业部署需扩展分割策略以处理不规则的复合运动，这是我们的下一步。

Keywords: clothes rack | wife | real curiosity
Q_EN: I loved your opening story. Did your wife actually buy into the scientific equipment argument? | Why did you really start this project? | Is the clothes rack safe now?
Q_ZH: 我很喜欢你的开场故事。你妻子真的相信这是科研设备了吗？ | 你到底为什么开始这个项目？ | 晾衣架现在安全了吗？
A_EN: (Smile) Well, getting accepted to VINCI definitely helped my case! But jokes aside, the personal motivation drove a genuine curiosity about why home fitness equipment feels so disconnected, which led to this semantic framework.
A_ZH: (微笑) 能被VINCI录用绝对帮了大忙！不开玩笑地说，个人动机驱使我真正去好奇为什么家用健身器材让人觉得毫无连结，从而催生了这个语义框架。

Keywords: exploratory | lightweight | discuss offline
Q_EN: Have you considered using advanced non-linear modeling like LSTMs for signal extraction? | What about deploying sensor fusion algorithms? | Why not use frequency-domain analysis?
Q_ZH: 你考虑过使用像LSTM这样的高级非线性建模来提取信号吗？ | 部署传感器融合算法怎么样？ | 为什么不用频域分析？
A_EN: That is an excellent point. Since this is an exploratory short paper, we deliberately kept the pipeline lightweight. Exploring that is exactly what we plan for our full-scale study, and I'd love to discuss it offline.
